review.finding: isAnswered had two gaps: a whitespace-only answer passed length>0 (visually blank 'answered' round, violating AC-b), and a null answer (the likely shape once a real, untyped fetch boundary replaces the stub) passed the !== undefined guard and would throw on .length.
review.fix: isAnswered now checks typeof round.answer === 'string' && round.answer.trim().length > 0. Added fixture tests for whitespace-only and null answers (OrgThread.test.tsx).

review.finding: data-round-index (and the index prop/parameter feeding it) was dead — referenced nowhere else; ordering is already proven via compareDocumentPosition in tests.
review.fix: Removed data-round-index, the index prop on Round, and the map's second parameter.

review.finding: The open badge carried both .thread-line (display:flex) and .thread-open (display:inline-block) at identical specificity, plus a duplicated margin-top declaration — source-order-dependent.
review.fix: Dropped the thread-line class from the open badge markup (it isn't a Q/A line); .thread-open now sets its own font-size/line-height explicitly.

review.finding: Returning a fresh {} per render is an unstable reference; the header comment's 'swap the body for a real fetch' understated that the call site and consumers change with it.
review.fix: Returns a module-level frozen EMPTY constant; comment now names that the real hook's shape (and OrgPage's call site) will change too.

review.finding: The round() test helper returned its input unchanged and added no type strictness over inline literals; the sibling test file already used plain literals, so the two files were inconsistent.
review.fix: Removed the helper; all fixtures are now inline object literals.

review.finding: The custom text matcher asserted el?.className === 'thread-text' (exact string), coupling the assertion to markup detail rather than rendered behavior.
review.fix: Replaced with within(answeredRound).getByText(MARKUP), scoped to the round via its testid rather than a class-name match.
